goal: Is ke baad aap loop ke andar loop likh sakte hain, i aur j ki values trace kar sakte hain, aur bata sakte hain ke inner body kitni dafa chalti hai.
warmup: Ghari ko dekhein. Har EK ghante ke liye minute ki sui poore 60 minute ka chakkar lagati hai. Ghanta aahista badalta hai, minute tezi se badalte hain. Ya class room ka socho: desks ki har row ke liye teacher us row ka har desk check karti hain. Nested loop bhi aisa hi hai. Outer loop ghante ya rows hain. Inner loop minute ya desks hain, aur woh outer loop ke aage barhne se pehle poora khatam hota hai.
definition: Nested loop woh loop hai jo kisi doosre loop ki body ke andar rakha ho. Outer loop tay karta hai ke inner loop kitni dafa shuru hoga. Outer loop ki har ek iteration ke liye inner loop shuru se aakhir tak chalta hai. Is liye agar outer loop R dafa chalta hai aur inner loop har dafa C dafa chalta hai, to inner body kul R x C dafa chalti hai.
howItWorks: Tarteeb ko follow karein. 1) Outer loop i = 1 set karta hai aur apni condition check karta hai. 2) Inner loop j = 1 set karta hai, apni body chalata hai, j++ karta hai, aur tab tak repeat karta hai jab tak uski condition false na ho jaye. 3) Program inner loop se bahar aata hai aur outer loop ke andar jo agla code hai woh chalata hai, aam taur par cout << endl;. 4) Outer loop i++ karta hai aur apni condition check karta hai. 5) Agar woh true ho to inner loop DOBARA j = 1 se shuru hota hai. Yehi asal idea hai: inner loop har outer iteration ke liye dobara shuru hota hai. Printing ka sunehri usool: outer loop rows (lines) ke liye hai, inner loop columns ke liye hai (har line par jo print hota hai), aur endl inner loop ke baad aata hai. Ginti: inner body kitni dafa chali = (outer iterations) x (inner iterations). Agar inner limit i par depend kare (maslan j <= i), to inner count har row mein badalta hai aur aap ko row counts jama karne parte hain: 1 + 2 + 3 + ... Dono loops ke liye alag variable names (i aur j) use karein. Multiplication table ko cell by cell bharte hue dekhne ke liye Visualize tab use karein.
